scenarios.name: no-graveyard-activity-still-triggers-and-does-nothing
scenarios.why: The 'if you've cast a spell from a graveyard or activated an ability of a card in a graveyard this turn' clause follows the draw effect, not the trigger condition, so it is not an intervening-if (CR 603.4 final sentence): the ability triggers at EVERY end step and the 2020-11-10 ruling says so. With no graveyard cast or graveyard-card activation this turn the condition is false as the ability resolves, so the ability does nothing and no card is drawn: hand size stays 0.

scenarios.name: graveyard-cast-triggers-and-draws
scenarios.why: Casting Firebolt with flashback satisfies 'you've cast a spell from a graveyard this turn', so the end-step ability triggers and the condition holds as the draw resolves: one card is drawn.
